Description: Repo skeleton, backlog and sprint documentation.
CRUD REST API for categories, products, cart and orders with fake seed data.
Customer storefront and admin screens for the quick delivery platform.
Dockerfiles and docker-compose for the whole stack.
Automated test, build, release and deploy pipelines.
Metrics, scraping and dashboards for the backend.
As a developer I want a clean repo layout so that all components have a home.

Summary: Write Jira backlog CSV and SCRUM docs
Description: As a team I want the backlog and sprint plan documented so that work is traceable.
As a developer I want Category, Product, CartItem, Order and OrderItem tables so that data can be stored in PostgreSQL.
As an admin I want to create, read, update and delete categories so that products can be grouped.
As an admin I want to manage products, and as a customer I want to search and filter them by name and category.
As a customer I want to add, update and remove items in my cart so that I can prepare an order.
As a customer I want to place an order from my cart with a fake payment and see its status and a 10 minute delivery ETA.
As a developer I want sample categories and products so that the app is usable immediately.
As a developer I want pytest tests for the API so that regressions are caught in CI.
As a developer I want the API containerised so that it runs the same everywhere.
As a developer I want a Vite React app with routing and an API client so that pages can be built.
As a customer I want to browse and search products by category so that I can find items quickly.

Summary: Admin product and category management UI
Description: As an admin I want forms to create, edit and delete products and categories.
As a customer I want to view and edit my cart and see the total.
As a customer I want to place a fake order and track its status with a 10 minute ETA.
As a developer I want the React build served by nginx in a container.
As a developer I want one command to start database, backend, frontend and monitoring.
As an operator I want healthchecks and env-based configuration so that services start in the right order.
As a team I want lint, test and build on every push and pull request.
As a team I want pushes to the release branch to build and publish Docker images to GHCR.
As a team I want a Jenkins server in docker-compose with the Docker CLI available.
As a team I want a Jenkins pipeline that checks out, builds, deploys with compose and smoke tests the app.

Summary: Expose Prometheus metrics from the API
Description: As an operator I want a /metrics endpoint so that request rate and latency can be scraped.
As an operator I want Prometheus scraping the backend every 5 seconds.
As an operator I want a provisioned dashboard showing request rate, latency and error count.
As a team I want the README to explain setup and usage so that the project can be demonstrated.
